sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 142.35M and the price on this page is from the confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 15:22 BRT (18:22 UTC). ONE NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED THIS THURSDAY, the PoderData poll of 03/Sep (BR-07561/2026, field 30/Aug to 02/Sep, n=3,000, margin of 2pp), commissioned by the institute itself, and its release was already on the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) register that the panel ingested that same morning, with the scheduled date and the registration number matching what was published. Two other national polls had releases scheduled for this Thursday, [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) (BR-03669/2026, n=2,002, field 01 to 03/Sep) and 100 Cidades (BR-02793/2026, n=2,000, field 28/Aug to 01/Sep), and neither had published figures at the time of this reading.
sentimento.text2: THE TOP TWO BOTH FELL ON THE SAME DAY, and that is what separates this round from the previous one. The leader gave up 1.00pp and stands at 54.50%, after five days flat at 55.50%. The runner-up gave up 0.30pp and stands at 40.35%. The gap between them narrowed for the second day running, from 16.55pp on 01/Sep to 14.85pp on 02/Sep and 14.15pp now, but for a different reason than yesterday: yesterday it narrowed because the runner-up rose 1.70pp, and today it narrows because the leader fell further than he did. The sum of the YES legs in the presidential book stands at 99.20%, meaning the price that left the top two did not show up under another name.
sentimento.text3: PoderData FLIPS THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) WITHIN ITS OWN HOUSE. The runner-up has 45% against 44% for the leader, and in the institute's two previous rounds it was the leader ahead, by 46% to 45% on 13/Aug and by 45% to 44% on 27/Aug. It is the first time the house series puts the runner-up numerically ahead in that pairing. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the house gives the leader 37% and the runner-up 34%. ⚠️ AND THE HOUSE FROM THE DAY BEFORE MEASURED THE OPPOSITE: Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 02/Sep, with a field window of 30/Aug to 01/Sep that overlaps almost entirely with this one, gave the leader ahead by 42% to 41%. Both margins are 1 point and they point in opposite directions, and both houses declare a margin of error of 2pp.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 40.35% (vol USD 9.59M accumulated) in the presidential book, down 0.30pp, and 85.50% in the first-round runner-up contract (vol USD 519 thousand), unchanged on the day. The PoderData poll of 03/Sep gives him 34% in the first round and 45% in a second round against the leader, who has 44%, the first result from this house in which he appears numerically ahead in that pairing. Within PoderData itself he went from 35% on 13/Aug and 35% on 27/Aug to 34% now, with the gap to the leader going from 6pp to 3pp and staying at 3pp. He used the crisis at the Supreme Court to try to build momentum for the 7 September rally, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 54.50% (vol USD 9.63M accumulated), down 1.00pp, which ends five days flat at 55.50%, and 8.75% in the first-round runner-up contract (vol USD 437 thousand), up 0.75pp. PoderData gives him 37% in the first round and 44% in a second round in which the runner-up has 45%. Within the house he went from 41% on 13/Aug to 38% on 27/Aug and 37% now. He wins the other three second-round pairings the house tested: 44% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 44% to 42% against Romeu Zema and 44% to 39% against Renan Santos. This Thursday, at 3pm at the Planalto Palace, he held the ceremony at which he declared the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) queue cleared, according to Poder360 and O Globo.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury has 10% in the PoderData first round, against 4% in the same house's round of 27/Aug, the same jump Genial/Quaest measured the day before going from 2% to 10%. In the price the move keeps going both ways: in the winner contract he FELL to 1.35% (vol USD 3.64M), down 0.25pp, and in the first-round third-place contract he ROSE to 55.85% (vol USD 108 thousand), up 3.45pp, the second straight day of gains in that contract. These are different questions: one is winning the election, the other is finishing third. Renan Santos has 3% in the poll and 1.75% (vol USD 12.48M) in the winner contract, down 0.45pp, and fell to 27.00% in the third-place contract. Ronaldo Caiado has 2% in the poll, remains below the 0.5% floor in the winner contract, and ROSE 2.50pp in the third-place contract, where he stands at 11.00% (vol USD 111 thousand).
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 15:22 BRT (18:22 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20 point. This round does not publish a new price for Ronaldo Caiado or Pablo Marçal in the winner contract, because both sit below the 0.5% floor. The presidential book has accumulated USD 142.35M.

inss.text1: THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) EVENT HAPPENED THIS THURSDAY, and the date matters because the panel recorded it the day before as an announcement already made. At 3pm at the Planalto Palace, Lula held the ceremony "Social Security Without a Queue", just over a month before the first round, according to Poder360.
inss.text2: ⚠️ AND THE BASIS FOR THE COUNT IS STATED IN THE SOURCE ITSELF: the government treats the queue as cleared when applications still inside the legal review deadline stop counting as pending, which does not mean nobody is waiting. The count excludes those waiting outside that criterion, according to O Globo. Initial applications stood at 1.55 million in July 2026, against 3.07 million in January of the same year.
inss.text3: The INSS case and the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case remain entangled at the Supreme Court, and the point of contact is still the same: the investigation that reached Justice Alexandre de Moraes began in the congressional INSS inquiry, according to RepórterMT. Ronaldo Caiado argued this Thursday that the Supreme Court should lift secrecy on every investigation into Banco Master, INSS and Dark Horse, according to Estadão.
inss.text4: The case remains open and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on the government's approval rating is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another, and the two do not add up.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval is still the Genial/Quaest poll of 02/Sep, with a field window of 30/Aug to 01/Sep: 45% approve and 48% disapprove, with 7% giving no answer. The PoderData poll of 03/Sep did not publish government approval in the table that was checked. In first-round voting intention PoderData puts the president at 37%, the same figure as the Quaest poll the day before.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture is one of stillness. On 05/Aug it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on 14/Aug 46% against 48% and on 02/Sep 45% against 48%. Disapproval repeats the same figure for the house's third round running. On the performance scale, 35% excellent or good, 25% fair and 37% poor or very poor, against 36%, 25% and 37% on 14/Aug. The panel deliberately keeps one house per block, so as not to add up yardsticks from different institutes.
inss.conclusao: On 03/Sep the news agenda was split between the Planalto and the Supreme Court, and the panel attributes the move in the presidential price to neither. What the series records is that the top two both fell on the same day, the leader by more than the runner-up, on the same day a national poll showed the second round between them flipped relative to the house from the day before.

bancoMaster.text1: WHAT CHANGED ON 3 SEPTEMBER IS A NEW PLEA DEAL, AND IT IS THE FIRST ONE TIED DIRECTLY TO THE DARK HORSE CASE. The Prosecutor General's Office closed a cooperation agreement with businessman Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior, owner of Entre Investimentos, according to Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo. His company allegedly channelled transfers from Daniel Vorcaro to the US-based Havengate Development Fund, which managed the film's money and forwarded amounts to the production company. ⚠️ THE AGREEMENT IS CLOSED AND NOT YET RATIFIED: the next step is sending it to the reporting justice.
bancoMaster.text2: THE SECOND PLEA DEAL IS FROM 2 SEPTEMBER, NOT TODAY, and the distinction is the same one. The Prosecutor General's Office signed the agreement with João Carlos Mansur, founder of the asset manager Reag, and sent the material to Justice André Mendonça's chambers, according to Poder360 and G1. The proposal had been submitted on 26 August. Mendonça still has to schedule a hearing with the cooperating witness and decide whether to ratify it, and without ratification the agreement does not count as evidence.
bancoMaster.text3: At the court, Gilmar Mendes proposed to Edson Fachin that [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) officers be barred from justices' chambers, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and in a meeting with Lula he instructed the Federal Police to push back against orders from Mendonça it considers unlawful, according to Estadão. The Paraná bar association asked for Moraes to be removed from the case and for the prosecutor general to be recused, according to Folha de S.Paulo. Poder360 reported that the institute linked to Mendonça held 55 contracts with public bodies.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The chronology is the information, and it now has seven distinct dates: the meeting between the justice and the businessman is from 14 March 2025; the messages are from 16 November 2025; the arrest is from 17 November 2025; the Federal Police report was delivered on 27 August 2026, the same day as the testimony taken without the Federal Police; secrecy was lifted on 1 September; the Reag founder's plea deal was signed on 2 September and went for ratification; and the plea deal with the businessman tied to Dark Horse was closed on 3 September. ⚠️ NEITHER PLEA DEAL HAS BEEN RATIFIED. And what has not happened yet is still scheduled: Mendonça's report on Moraes is expected on 7 or 8 September, according to Poder360.

stf.toffoli: No new individual action on 03/Sep. His ruling that unblocked Renan Santos's digital campaign is from 01/Sep. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, alongside Moraes, according to G1 and Poder360.
stf.moraes: STILL THE NAME OF THE DAY, AND AGAIN NOT THROUGH ANY ACTION OF HIS OWN. The Paraná bar association asked for his removal from the case and for the prosecutor general to be recused, according to Folha de S.Paulo. Ronaldo Caiado argued for his removal and for impeachment in the Senate, according to Valor Econômico. A former prosecutor general said he needs to be investigated and that the current one should step away from the Master case, according to Folha de S.Paulo and the BBC.
stf.gilmar: HE PROPOSED TO FACHIN THAT FEDERAL POLICE OFFICERS BE BARRED FROM SUPREME COURT CHAMBERS, according to Folha de S.Paulo, a measure that responds directly to the testimony taken in Mendonça's chambers without the Federal Police. In a meeting with Lula, he instructed the Federal Police to push back against orders from Mendonça when it considers them unlawful, according to Estadão.
stf.dino: No new individual action captured on 03/Sep.
stf.mendonca: He received from the Prosecutor General's Office the Reag founder's plea agreement so he can rule on ratification, according to Poder360 and G1. He is the one who schedules the hearing with the cooperating witness and decides whether the agreement counts as evidence. Poder360 reported that the institute linked to him held 55 contracts with public bodies. His report on Moraes is still expected on 7 or 8 September.
stf.nexo: THE CRISIS HAS STARTED PRODUCING PROPOSED RULES, NOT JUST REACTIONS. Gilmar Mendes proposed barring Federal Police officers from the court's chambers, Chief Justice Edson Fachin continued his talks with the other justices and spoke of dialogue and tolerance to strengthen democracy at the elections, and Lula met with Fachin and with Gilmar, according to Poder360, Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão. On the same day the Prosecutor General's Office closed the first plea deal tied to the Dark Horse case and handed the reporting justice the Reag founder's plea deal.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving through impeachment before 2027 stands at 7.40% (vol USD 87 thousand) in the confirmed reading of 03/Sep, 15:22 BRT (18:22 UTC), up 1.05pp against the 6.35% published on 02/Sep. ⚠️ AND YESTERDAY'S CAVEAT APPLIES AGAIN, NOW IN THE THIRD DIRECTION IN A ROW: this is the smallest book on the panel and accumulated volume is still USD 87 thousand, meaning the day's new money is negligible. Over three days the contract went to 10.85%, fell to 6.35% and rose to 7.40%, and the entire book traded since it opened fits into less than one hundredth of the presidential book. A price that moves a lot on very little money does not describe a shift in expectations of the same size. The contract measures a justice leaving, not whether the investigation goes anywhere nor whether the Senate takes up the request.
